slides.title: Where should the next billion come from?
slides.text: Fans pay either way. Only one of them asks fans what they want.
slides.source: Photos: The Kop, Anfield, FYI2023 / Wikimedia Commons (CC0); TANNMY NAISZE Wanguo / Wikimedia Commons (CC0)

slides.title: What clubs should take from this

points.head: Fans are the asset
points.text: Every revenue line traces back to someone who cares.

points.head: Ask before you price
points.text: Ticket rows start when fans feel ignored, not charged.

points.head: Digital is the gap
points.text: Clubs know their sponsors better than their supporters.
